knowledge:
- key_parameters: method=In createBinaryImage, specifies the thresholding algorithm ("otsu" or "phansalkar") ;; maxShape=In segmentImage/classifyCells/calculateCellularity, the maximum size of cell nuclei above which objects are re-segmented ;; minShape=In segmentImage/classifyCells/calculateCellularity, the minimum size of cell nuclei below which objects are discarded ;; failureRegion=In segmentImage/classifyCells/calculateCellularity, the size threshold above which dark artifact regions are deleted ;; KS=In classifyCells/calculateCellularity, a boolean indicating whether to use kernel smoothing for classification ;; cancerIdentifier=In calculateCellularity/processAperio, the class label representing tumor cells ;; numSections=In processAperio, the number of tissue sections to automatically cluster and analyze separately
- alternatives: EBImage package is recommended for general image reading, writing, and basic manipulation (e.g., readImage, channel, display) before or after CRImage processing
- when_to_use: Use when you need to segment and classify cell nuclei in tissue images, calculate tumor cellularity from H&E slides, process large-scale Aperio scanner images, or adjust DNA copy number data for tumor purity/cellularity
- pitfalls: When manually editing the training set table in external spreadsheet software, be extremely careful not to shift columns ;; The classification system supports a maximum of 10 classes ;; If using the kernel smoothing (KS=TRUE) approach, you must either have exactly two classes or explicitly specify the cancer class

workflows.name: cell_classification_and_cellularity
workflows.intent: Segment cells, classify cell types using a trained classifier, and calculate tumor cellularity from a tissue image.
input: trainingData.txt (tab-separated table of cell features and class labels)
workflows.stages: 1. Load training data and train an SVM classifier using createClassifier ;; 2. Classify cells in the target image using classifyCells ;; 3. Calculate tumor cellularity using calculateCellularity
workflows.code:
t = system.file("extdata", "trainingData.txt", package="CRImage")
trainingData=read.table(t,header=TRUE)
classifier=createClassifier(trainingData)[[1]]
f = system.file("extdata", "exImg2.jpg", package="CRImage")
classValues=classifyCells(classifier,filename=f,KS=TRUE,maxShape=800,minShape=40,failureRegion=2000)
cellularity=calculateCellularity(classifier=classifier,filename=f,KS=TRUE,maxShape=800,minShape=40,failureRegion=2000,classifyStructures=FALSE,cancerIdentifier="1",numDensityWindows=2,colors=c("green","red"))

workflows.name: aperio_slide_processing
workflows.intent: Process large-scale pathological images from Aperio scanners by analyzing subimages in parallel and calculating section-specific cellularity.
input: trainingData.txt (tab-separated table of cell features and class labels)
workflows.stages: 1. Train the classifier using createClassifier ;; 2. Create an output directory ;; 3. Process subimages, perform automatic section clustering, and output cellularity values and heatmaps using processAperio
workflows.code:
t = system.file("extdata", "trainingData.txt", package="CRImage")
trainingData=read.table(t,header=TRUE)
classifier=createClassifier(trainingData)[[1]]
dir.create("AperiOutput")
f = system.file("extdata",  package="CRImage")
processAperio(classifier=classifier,inputFolder=f,outputFolder="AperiOutput",identifier="Da",numSections=2,cancerIdentifier="c",maxShape=800,minShape=40,failureRegion=2000)

workflows.name: copy_number_correction
workflows.intent: Correct DNA copy number log-ratios (LRR) and beta allele frequencies (BAF) for tumor cellularity.
input: z (data frame containing genomic coordinates, LRR, and BAF values)
workflows.stages: 1. Correct copy number values for a given tumor purity/cellularity using correctCopyNumber ;; 2. Plot the corrected copy number profiles using plotCorrectedCN
workflows.code:
LRR <- c(rnorm(100, 0, 1), rnorm(10, -2, 1), rnorm(20, 3, 1), rnorm(100,0, 1)) 
BAF <- c(rnorm(100, 0.5, 0.1), rnorm(5, 0.2, 0.01), rnorm(5, 0.8, 0.01), rnorm(10, 0.25, 0.1), rnorm(10, 0.75, 0.1), rnorm(100,0.5, 0.1)) 
Pos <- sample(x=1:500, size=230, replace=TRUE)
Pos <- cumsum(Pos)
Chrom <- rep(1, length(LRR))
z <- data.frame(Name=1:length(LRR), Chrom=Chrom, Pos=Pos, LRR=LRR, BAF=BAF)
res <- correctCopyNumber(arr="Sample1", chr=1, p=0.75, z=z)
plotCorrectedCN(res, chr=1)
